Paul stuck to the task and gradually got back into his stride managing to achieve the target with some time to spare and thus join that select band of Belgravians who have qualified to call…
Born in 1914, George joined the Club during war time in August 1943 and was also a member of Gravesend AC. In 1945 he resigned from the Kent Club and ran in Belgrave colours in various events.

She was born in Port of Spain, Trinidad, in 1944, and was one of seven children born to Dolly and George. At Provident Girls High School she competed in the annual sports day events but her main sporting interest was netball at which she represented her school.
